zones.name: Bijrani Zone
zones.desc: Known for rich wildlife diversity, wide grasslands (chaurs), and frequent tiger sightings.

zones.name: Dhikala Zone
zones.desc: The largest and most famed zone with stunning panoramic views of the Patli Dun valley and Ramganga river.

zones.name: Jhirna Zone
zones.desc: Open throughout the year, featuring dry deciduous forest and dense bamboo thickets favored by sloth bears and tigers.

zones.name: Dhela Zone
zones.desc: An ecological buffer zone with mixed forest, rich birdlife, and grassland trails.

zones.name: Garjiya Zone
zones.desc: High tiger density landscape with scenic ridge trails along the Kosi river basin.

zones.name: Phato Zone
zones.desc: A thriving eco-tourism zone known for elephants, leopards, and tiger trail crossings.

guidelines: Safari permits are non-transferable and non-refundable under Forest Department guidelines.
Original Photo ID (Aadhaar / Passport / Voter ID) used during booking must be carried during entry.
Bookings open 45 days in advance for Indian citizens and 90 days for foreign nationals.
